Inside, highlights include heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, 12-inch digital instrument cluster, SYNC 4 infotainment, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, premium audio, and advanced driver-assistance technology. A Twin-Panel Moonroof further enhances the cabin.

Combining high-output performance, specialized off-road engineering, and impressive technology, this 2026 F-150 Raptor is an exceptionally capable performance truck.

description:
The 2026 BMW X7 xDrive40i represents thoughtful engineering and refined capability for drivers who demand both performance and versatility in a premium luxury SUV.

- 22 V-Spoke Wheels with Summer Performance Tires
- M Sport Professional Package with M Sport Brakes and Illuminated Kidney Grille
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with Highway Assistant and Parking View with 3D Surround
- Executive Package with Heated and Cooled Cup Holders, Front Massaging Seats, and Panoramic Sky Lounge LED Roof
- Climate Comfort Package with 5-Zone Automatic Climate Control and Front Ventilated Seats
- Second Row Captain's Chairs
- M Sport Exhaust System with Extended Shadowline Trim
- Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System with SiriusXM
- Live Cockpit Pro with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heated Steering Wheel and Memory Seats
- BMW Maps Navigation System
- Trailer Hitch with Trailer Assistant
- 4-Wheel Independent Adaptive Suspension
- Front and Rear Heated Seats
- Power Moonroof with Electric Rear Side Window Shades

This BMW combines a 3.0L turbocharged inline-six engine with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering 21 city and 25 highway MPG. The adaptive suspension system adjusts to road conditions while the speed-sensing steering responds to driving dynamics, creating a composed and confident driving experience across different terrains and speeds.

The interior showcases multiple levels of comfort and convenience. Second-row captain's chairs provide individual seating with enhanced comfort, while the massaging front seats and climate comfort technology address long-distance driving needs. The five-zone automatic climate control ensures each occupant finds their preferred temperature, and the panoramic sky lounge roof floods the cabin with natural light.

Technology integration reflects BMW's commitment to connected driving. The Driving Assistance Professional package includes hands-off highway assistant capability up to 85 mph on limited access highways, automatic parking, and lane change assistance. The backup assistant and trailer assistant features add practical utility, while the 3D surround-view parking camera system enhances visibility during low-speed maneuvers.

The M Sport Professional package elevates visual presence with distinctive design elements including the illuminated kidney grille, M sport brakes with black calipers, and aerodynamic enhancements. Twenty-two inch V-spoke wheels with summer performance tires complete the purposeful stance, while the extended shadowline trim and M sport exhaust system reinforce the performance character.

Your journey in this X7 xDrive40i begins with a visit to our showroom, where our team can walk you through its extensive features and arrange your test drive.

The 2024 Land Rover Defender 130 Outbound represents serious capability wrapped in a thoughtfully designed package built for those who demand both performance and practicality. This gray three-row SUV combines rugged engineering with refined amenities, delivering a vehicle that transitions seamlessly from daily driving to genuine off-road adventure.

- Connected Navigation PIVI Pro
- 400W 11 Speaker Meridian Sound System with SiriusXM
- 12-Way Heated & Cooled Electric Memory Front Seats
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Power Moonroof
- Heated Steering Wheel
- 20 Gloss Black Style 5095 Alloy Wheels
- Adaptive Suspension with Four Wheel Independent Setup
- Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Front and Rear Fog Lights
- Rear Exterior Parking Camera
- Split Folding Rear Seat
- Dual Front Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Speed-Sensing Steering and Steering Wheel Memory
- HomeLink Garage Door Transmitter

Under the hood, the 3.0L I6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers the power you need with efficiency you'll appreciate. The 3.55 axle ratio provides balanced performance whether you're navigating city streets or tackling varied terrain. Real-world fuel economy of 16 city and 18 highway miles per gallon reflects this vehicle's substantial size and capability.

The interior prioritizes comfort and convenience for all occupants. The 12-way heated and cooled front seats adapt to changing conditions and driver preference, while the heated steering wheel adds warmth on cold mornings. The Meridian sound system with 11 speakers creates an immersive audio environment, complemented by SiriusXM satellite radio access. Navigation powered by Connected PIVI Pro keeps you oriented, and seamless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration connects your smartphone effortlessly.

Safety and control features work together to inspire confidence. Standard electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist systems combine with four-wheel disc brakes and dual front airbags to protect occupants. The adaptive suspension system and four-wheel independent setup absorb impacts while maintaining composure across different driving surfaces.

Practical details enhance everyday usability. Auto-dimming door mirrors and rear-view mirror reduce glare, rain-sensing wipers operate intuitively, and the rear window wiper clears obstruction from behind. Remote keyless entry with a security system protects your investment, while power windows, door mirrors, and the tilt-away steering wheel add convenience to routine operations.

The Defender 130 Outbound arrives with 19,008 miles on the odometer, representing a vehicle that's been carefully maintained and is ready for its next chapter. This is your opportunity to step into a three-row SUV that balances genuine capability with the comfort and technology features that make modern ownership straightforward and enjoyable.

This SX-Prestige model combines three-row practicality and upscale appointments while the available *Towing Package* adds confidence for weekend trailers and gear without changing the Telluride s refined character.

*Towing Package* Equip your Telluride to handle hauling duties with added durability and peace of mind, so outdoor gear and small trailers become part of everyday plans rather than special arrangements.

*Smart device mirroring* brings your phone s navigation and entertainment to the center display in a way that s easier to use while driving, helping you stay connected without taking attention off the road.

*Remote parking* lets you maneuver into tight spaces from outside the vehicle, simplifying crowded lot situations and making it easier to get in and out when doors are blocked.

*Front pedestrian impact prevention* enhances city and neighborhood driving by actively scanning ahead and taking corrective action if a pedestrian is detected, adding another layer of protection for vulnerable road users.

*Automatic curve slowdown cruise control* uses navigation data to temper speed for upcoming bends and hills, smoothing long drives and helping reduce fatigue on winding routes.

*Mobile hotspot* keeps passengers connected through the vehicle s private network so multiple devices can stream or work without tapping into personal data plans.

*Rear camera with washer* maintains a clearer view behind the vehicle in messy conditions, making reverse maneuvers and parking more confident even when the weather is less than ideal.

*Lane departure prevention* helps keep the Telluride centered in its lane by intervening when unintended drifting is detected, supporting safer, more controlled highway travel.

*Active blind spot system* reduces the stress of lane changes by warning of hidden vehicles and intervening when a lane change could be unsafe, helping to prevent side collisions.

*Rear collision mitigation* prepares the vehicle and its occupants if a rear impact is likely, activating systems designed to reduce potential injury and damage.

*Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go* manages both speed and following distance in heavy traffic, bringing the vehicle to a stop and resuming as traffic flows to ease the burden of congested commutes.

Altogether, the 2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid SX-Prestige AWD offers roomy three-row comfort, modern connectivity, and a broad suite of active safety aids, now with added towing capability for those who need it. This 2019 Mercedes-Benz GLC 300 offers a refined driving experience backed by Mercedes-Benz engineering and quality.

- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Premium audio system: COMAND® with Single CD and Radio Data System
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- Leather Steering Wheel with Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Power Driver Seat with Memory Function
- All-Wheel Independent Suspension
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Emergency Communication System: mbrace
- Dual Front and Side Impact Airbags with Knee Airbag
- Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Roof Rack Rails
- 18 5-Spoke Alloy Wheels
- Remote Keyless Entry with Homelink Garage Door Transmitter
- Rain Sensing Wipers with Rear Window Wiper

The exterior presents a clean White finish with body-color bumpers, heated power mirrors, and fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality. The 18-inch alloy wheels complement the vehicle's contemporary styling while the roof rack rails provide practical versatility for your storage needs.

Inside, the cabin combines comfort with functionality. Heated front bucket seats with MB-Tex upholstery provide support for daily driving, while the power driver seat with memory settings ensures personalized positioning. The leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls allows you to manage your entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel. The automatic temperature control maintains your preferred climate with front dual-zone capability, and the rear window defroster enhances visibility in challenging weather.

The COMAND® premium audio system with Single CD player and radio data system delivers quality sound through six speakers. Additional conveniences include the Homelink garage door transmitter, trip computer, outside temperature display, and overhead console for organized storage.

Safety is paramount in this GLC 300, featuring dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, and an overhead airbag system. The exterior parking camera provides rear visibility when reversing, while electronic stability control, traction control, and anti-lock brakes work together to maintain vehicle control. Emergency communication via mbrace connects you to assistance when needed.

Powered by a 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with a nine-speed automatic transmission, this GLC delivers 22 city miles per gallon and 27 highway miles per gallon. The rear-wheel drive configuration provides responsive handling while the four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections for a composed ride.

This 2019 Mercedes-Benz GLC 300 represents a practical choice for those seeking a blend of luxury, safety, and dependable transportation.

This striking 2020 Mercedes-Benz GLE 350 4MATIC arrives wrapped in exclusive MANUFAKTUR Lunar Blue Metallic, a rich, deep hue that catches the light with a sophisticated shimmer and instantly sets this SUV apart from the ordinary. Rolling on handsome 20-inch 10-spoke wheels and finished with a chrome load sill guard, it presents a commanding yet elegant presence that feels equally at home gliding through the city or heading out for a weekend escape.

Step inside and the cabin envelops you in a warm, inviting atmosphere of ARTICO man-made leather sport seats in beige, beautifully complemented by a Macchiato Beige headliner and Dark Grey Linden wood trim that adds a refined, natural elegance. Heated and ventilated front seats keep you perfectly comfortable in every season, while 64-color ambient lighting lets you set the mood with a subtle glow that transforms the interior after dark. The Burmester Surround Sound System fills the space with rich, concert-hall audio that makes every drive feel like an event, and thoughtful conveniences like NFC wireless charging, a 115-volt power outlet, and SiriusXM radio keep you connected and entertained.

Confidence comes standard with the Parking Assist Package, including a Surround View System that gives you a bird s-eye perspective for effortless maneuvering in tight spaces. Out on the road, the responsive turbocharged powertrain and 4MATIC all-wheel drive deliver composed, capable performance whether you re commuting or towing, thanks to the factory trailer hitch and increased towing capacity that add real-world versatility without sacrificing the refined Mercedes-Benz ride.

This GLE 350 4MATIC is more than transportation it s a beautifully appointed luxury SUV that blends distinctive style, everyday comfort, and intelligent capability into one compelling package ready for whatever comes next.
